# AI Insights

Date range:Last 7 days

## AI bot & crawler traffic

Copy link

AI bots scan public websites to collect data used in search engines, AI model training, and other data processing tasks

Industry setIndustry sets are manually curated collections of related industries.

---

## Adoption of AI agent standards

Copy link

Standards adoption across  of the top 200,000 scanned domains

[Learn more...](https://isitagentready.com)Share this...More actions...

Domain category

[Scan your website for agent readiness](https://isitagentready.com)

These checks measure adoption of AI agent standards across successfully scanned domains. Out of the top 200,000, we exclude categories not meaningful for agent readiness analysis — such as Search Engines, or Empty and Unreachable infrastructure. Not all standards are applicable to every website — for example, x402 is only relevant for sites with paid content, and WebMCP for sites exposing tools to AI agents.
